scope: Single real layer15 step64 B3 GQA8 head2 capture; production BH page1 native E0 O-only plus mandatory output copy. Not full model.
qualification: All arms same logical support order/lengths/native plan, BF16 input replicas bitwise; output and raw LSE bitwise, output FP64 atol .006 rtol .015. Any failure stops timing and remains charged.

cache_regimes.hot: Self-warm before every 32-call graph chain; repeated one-layer working set.
cache_regimes.cold: One call only, >2 L2 flush outside timer; retain 2.048us event quantization limit. No cold chain averaging.

interpretation: Only effects of physical address sharing on this native operation. Active footprint, TLB, partitioning and cache reuse may all contribute. No DRAM/L2-counter or application claim. 8 cells on 8 GPUs; within-cell paired effects only, no cross-budget device causal claim.
cold_reporting_gate: For a directional latency claim require bootstrap ratio CI excludes 1, median absolute latency difference >=2.048us, and difference exceeds both A/A absolute shifts; otherwise unresolved at this timing resolution.
mapping_installation: One wrapper/plan/Q/output/workspace/indices buffer shared by all arms; copy prepared arm indices to that buffer outside timer before hot self-warm or cold flush. Installation is not included in attention time.
address_sensitive_graph_qualification: For every captured graph, replace each physical replica V with 17, require only mapped request rows change to 17 within BF16 .05 absolute, unmapped requests bitwise unchanged; restore and require original output bitwise.
